# ROOTS-AI™ — report-review point 21 content matrix

**ROOTS decision, 29 September 2026, item 6:** point 21 remains **open**. This matrix is the
review instrument the decision asks for, prepared "using the existing approved content only".

**Generated by** `npm run evidence:point21`. Every approved string is read from the controlled
content module, and the rendered-text column is produced by the real report builder, so what is
reviewed below is exactly what a participant sees.

**Nothing in this document is newly authored.** Per the decision, no cell has been filled with
physiological or medical claims, and no variations have been generated to make the 28
combinations sound different. The interpretation column is deliberately empty.

**To work in rather than read:** the same 28 rows are in
[`docs/m3/evidence/Point21_Content_Matrix_FOR_ROOTS.xlsx`](evidence/Point21_Content_Matrix_FOR_ROOTS.xlsx),
prepared for the review of 29 September 2026, item 1. Four decision columns are empty and
unlocked — whether the combination requires additional content, the approved wording, its
content identifier, and notes. Every column carrying controlled content is locked, and the sheet
is protected without a password, so the guard is against a slip rather than against ROOTS.
Build it with `npm run evidence:point21 && npm run evidence:point21-xlsx`; a completed copy
should be returned under a different name, because regenerating overwrites the file.

## The four approved classification explanations

C-03 supplies one explanation per classification. They are keyed to the classification, not to
the domain, which is the mechanism behind the repetition point 21 describes: any two domains
sharing a classification necessarily read identically at this point.

| Classification | C-02 range | C-02 approved interpretation | C-03 participant-facing explanation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Optimized | 0-24 | Lower reported burden | Few burden signals were reported in this area. |
| Compensating | 25-49 | Signals present; compensation appears active | Some signals are present, while current routines may still be helping your system compensate. |
| Strained | 50-74 | Multiple or frequent signals | Several signals may be placing consistent pressure on this area. |
| Dysregulated | 75-100 | High reported burden; educational prompt to seek appropriate support | A high burden of signals was reported. This is not a diagnosis; consider discussing persistent or concerning symptoms with a qualified professional. |

## The seven approved domain meanings

| Domain | Label | C-03 approved meaning |
|---|---|---|
| MR | Metabolic Resistance™ | Self-reported resistance to expected weight change and activity-related metabolic context. |
| HS | Hunger & Satiety Signals™ | Hunger, craving, fullness and post-meal response patterns. |
| SR | Sleep Recovery Index™ | Sleep duration, continuity and perceived restoration. |
| CH | Circadian Health Score™ | Alignment of light, screen, meal and sleep timing. |
| SL | Stress Load™ | Perceived tension, cognitive activation and stress-linked eating. |
| IB | Inflammation Burden Index™ | Non-specific symptom burden; not a laboratory or clinical inflammation measure. |
| BS | Biological Safety Signals™ | Perceived energy, appetite drive and resistance signals. |

## What we are not doing, and why

Two routes would close point 21, and both are closed to the vendor:

1. **Authoring the 28 strings ourselves** would mean composing participant-facing interpretive
   language about metabolic, sleep, stress and inflammation signals. That is content authority
   we do not hold, and the decision forbids "newly authored physiological or medical claims".
2. **Generating them** is excluded by review point 21 itself: "Do not solve repetition by
   allowing unrestricted AI rewriting."

The approved current presentation is therefore retained unchanged, and point 21 stays open in
the report-review checklist and the Decision Log.

## What ROOTS is asked to determine

Per the decision: "ROOTS will determine which combinations genuinely require additional
approved content." Any additions will be issued as a controlled C-03 content amendment with
content identifiers, permitted conditions and tests.

Constraints the decision records as remaining in force, which any addition must preserve:

- the four existing classification explanations and their medical boundaries, unless a
  controlled amendment expressly changes them;
- deterministic classifications — no added content may alter how a score or classification is
  produced;
- non-diagnostic framing and the approved safety guidance.

**Closure:** point 21 closes after the applicable content is approved, implemented and
verified. Accepting the current presentation instead would require a separate, explicit ROOTS
decision changing the review requirement; the decision of 29 September expressly does not issue
one.
